answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The garden is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zephyr. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the mirror of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
